_comment: Guardrail budgets enforced by CI. Only the Director may raise these, with a DECISIONS.md entry explaining why.

playerFrameMs._comment: Real players' frame times from telemetry (#373), held by the studio-health watchdog (scripts/playerTelemetry.cjs): a level whose median phone-session p95 frame time over 24 h (3+ sessions) is above touchP95 gets a studio-health issue. 33.4 ms: the VISION bar is 60 fps on a mid-range phone, and a p95 past two vsyncs means visible stutter.

smokeSeconds._comment: Wall time of each CI smoke shard (e2e/shards.mjs), checked by the smoke on CI (#353): 1.5x the slowest CI run on #411 (2026-11-07, the PR depth of #372: four runs, ui and menus one; runs swung up to ~60%), rounded up to 30 s, ui and menus to 120 s; mobile 1.3x. Over budget is a warning; a shard fails only past 1.5x it (scaled up for a slow runner, e2e/shardTime.mjs, #487).

scene._comment: Per-level ceilings checked by the smoke (#188): drawCalls at the ride screenshot (camera-dependent: +20% over the higher of two runs on 2026-10-31; level4 and level5 hold the VISION bar of 250, #260), scene and track (objects named track*) objects and triangles from sceneStats() (camera-independent: +15%). knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands. Since #925 a target counts only when the rider can shoot it (`sight()`: in view, readable, in sight) on a run played as a player (3 hits a game second), and `bossFramedShare` is the least share of the boss fight with a shootable weak point. Levels 1–5 re-set on 2026-11-23 from their first CI run under that count (seed 1337): the longest gap +1 s and the share +2 points up to the next 5% (both a little more where two runs differed), the boss floor 5 points under, down to the next 5%, so nothing gets worse; the targets are 3 s, 10% and 0.6 (#937). title (#376): the title scene, its drawCalls at the two title screenshots, objects and triangles; raised by the Director on 2026-11-09 for the title world (#436 → #454 / #459, DECISIONS "Week 4"): 140 / 130 / 60 000 are ceilings for a dense instanced park, not targets (was 114 / 89 / 11 356 = the 7 Nov scene +20% / +15%). level1 (200: the lift hill's balloon rings in the 10 s shot, #955) and level3 (98: the Ocean ride's first lift looks over the lagoon, #895) raised by the Director on 2026-11-24. level6 raised by the Director on 2026-11-16 (DECISIONS "Week 5"): 130 draws / 160 objects (was 60 / 110, its first smoke before climbers, the Medusa on screen and the fire; #554, #557, #583), still under the VISION bar of 250.

pacing._comment: Time with nothing to shoot over a whole run, per level (#450): the smoke's nightly `pacing` step (e2e/pacingMetric.mjs) fails a level whose longest gap with no shootable target on screen (seconds of level time; the first 2 s after GO and the boss tell left out) or share of the run with none is over these. Set on 2026-11-09 from the higher of two local runs per level (seed 1337, 0.5 s steps; a level's longest gap moved up to 2 s between runs, its share up to 5 points): the longest gap +1 s, the share +2 points rounded up to the next 5%, so today's levels pass and nothing gets worse. Lowered for level4 and level5 by the wave placement fix (#451) on the same rule from its measured runs. The Director lowers them further. level7 lowered on the #925 rule from the pacing step on CI once its drone waves came in rings on the rails ahead, each about a second sooner (#950: 48%, longest gap 4.5 s at 33.5 s before the boss, from 46% / 4.5 s at 21 s; the review measured 42% / 2.4 s, seed 1337), its Helicopter (#967, #968) on the #925 rule from the pacing step on CI (shootable 7.0 s of a 17 s fight, 41%, out of sight 9.0 s from 44 s; the review measures 70%: 2.3 s of a 3.3 s fight), with knownOverOnly: "boss" until #989 reaches the 60% target. level1 on the #937 targets (3 s / 10% / boss 60%) once its lift-hill rings and the Blimp's lead through the finale helix met them (review 1.4 s / 6% / 96%, pacing step 2.0 s / 6%, seed 1337). level4 lowered on the #925 rule from its review once its waves held each storyboard stretch, trackside snowmen stood where the terrain doesn't hide them and the Yeti's chest opened half of each roar cycle (5.0 s / 43% / 27%, seed 1337; #937 goes on to the targets). Its boss floor on the #937 target, and the share on the rule from the pacing step, once the Yeti picked and held a ridge with its head low enough in the rider's frame (pacing step 41% / 4.5 s at 20 s / boss 3.5 of 4 s; review 35% / 2.8 s / boss 83%, seed 1337). Then on the rule from the pacing step, the share with CI's margin as level2's, once a small wave came every ~2 s and the roster grew to 42 scouts, 49 snowmen and 22 brutes, each one hit, so a player meets about two a second (#937: pacing step 28% / 3.5 s at 6 s / boss 4.5 of 5 s; review 24% / 3.1 s / boss 3.9 of 5 s, seed 1337; what is left is the lift, pitched at the sky, and the crest over the ice cave's dome). level3 lowered once its jellyfish came in a small line every 2 s, up the lift and on past the sea stacks: the gap and boss floor on the #937 targets, the share on the #925 rule from the pacing step on CI (13%, longest gap 1.5 s at 7 s, boss shootable 6.5 of 8 s; the review measured 1.0 s / 9% / boss 86%, seed 1337), then its share on the #937 target once lines of 7 held the lift and the sharks and the flying fish each came a second sooner, before the line ahead of them was out of view (#1029: review 4%, no gap of 1 s, boss 83%, seed 1337). level2 lowered by its retimed waves (#937: review 3.3 s / 24% / boss 88%, seed 1337), then by scorpions on the Pyramid passage's floor in the dark ride and a V every 4 s to the boss (#937: review 1.5 s / 10% / boss 88%, pacing step 1.5 s / 10% / 92%, seed 1337; CI's pacing step has measured 5–7 points more share than local runs): the gap on the target, the share at 0.2 for CI's margin, the boss floor on the target. knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands; with knownOverOnly: "boss" only the boss floor warns (level6 until #945 (its waves; the ride was #926): its gap and share on the #925 rule from its first played CI run, 16.0 s / 71%, its boss floor on the target).
